name: Nimetazepam
summary: A pharmaceutical benzodiazepine with hypnotic sedative effects. The drug is reported to have high amounts of use and abuse in Malaysia.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It possesses powerful hypnotic, anxiolytic, sedative, and skeletal muscle relaxant properties.

uses.text: Nimetazepam (marketed under brand name Erimin and Lavol) is an intermediate-acting hypnotic drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. Outside of Japan, Erimin was available in much of East and Southeast Asia and was widely prescribed for the short-term treatment of severe insomnia in patients who had difficulty falling asleep or maintaining sleep. It is primarily used as an anticonvulsant in children.

summaryZh: 硝甲西泮，又譯硝甲氮平，其作用為中樞神經抑制劑。俗稱一粒眠，屬中華民國三級管制性藥品，又稱「紅豆」、「五仔」、「K它命5號」、「Give me Five」。
summaryZhHans: 硝甲西泮，又译硝甲氮平，其作用为中枢神经抑制剂。俗称一粒眠，属中华民国三级管制性药品，又称“红豆”、“五仔”、“K它命5号”、“Give me Five”。

sideEffects.en: Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: Nimetazepam was first made in 1962 and sold in Japan as Erimin. Its tablets became widely misused in parts of Southeast Asia, particularly Malaysia.
fact.zh: 硝甲西泮在 1962 年首次合成，並在日本以 Erimin 的商品名販售。它的錠劑在東南亞部分地區，尤其是馬來西亞，曾被廣泛濫用。
fact.zhHans: 硝甲西泮在 1962 年首次合成，并在日本以 Erimin 的商品名贩售。它的锭剂在东南亚部分地区，尤其是马来西亚，曾被广泛滥用。
